subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A sentimental memory of the past
solution:
The correct answer is: **Nostalgia**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nostalgia **means a sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past. (अतीत के प्रति भावनात्मक लालसा या वात्सल्यपूर्ण स्नेह)
 
• It is a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
 
• **For example**: *She felt a wave of nostalgia as she walked through her childhood home.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hysteria **means uncontrollable emotion or excitement. (अनियंत्रित भावना या उत्तेजना)
 
• **Mania **means an excessive enthusiasm or desire for something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति अत्यधिक उत्साह या इच्छा)
 
• **Euphoria **means a feeling of intense happiness or excitement. (तीव्र ख़ुशी या उत्साह की अनुभूति)
